title: Full Ashfall Overview
subtitle: The official Ashfall pack profile with Ashfall theme, docs, metadata, and export checks.
summary: The official Ashfall profile starter for ECHO Launcher exports, preserving Ashfall as Official ECHO Pack #1 and keeping its content isolated from generic templates.
body:
Install the official profile, review Ashfall docs, validate required modules, then export client or server packs.

First 30 minutes:
- Read the Ashfall install notes.
- Confirm required modules and official theme metadata.
- Review the known issues and server notes.
- Run diagnostics before publishing an export.

First 2 hours:
- Validate client and server export profiles.
- Review official Index and Terminal content registration.
- Keep Ashfall-specific content inside the official profile namespace.
